❓ HOW TO PLAY

🌽 You are Corn Man. A storm scattered the barn across the farm. This is an adventure — like the original 8-bit Zelda, there is no level list. You explore the farm one screen at a time and must find each of the 8 barns yourself: a barn door at the far end of a field, a cellar hatch across the creek, stairs hidden in the corn maze, a hatch under a tombstone, a door in the silo… Walk up to a farmer or a sign for a cryptic hint, and try things — pushing a tombstone or a hay bale can reveal a secret!

🏚️ Inside a barn: each barn is the inside of a rundown farmhouse or barn — connected rooms, one screen each, with doors in the walls. Every barn is much bigger than it used to be — 15 to 25 rooms (never more than 25), winding through the shape of that level's big end guy. Clear every pest in the shutter room to open its sliding shutter door. Padlocked doors need a rusty key 🗝️ (keys work in any barn). Push a crate onto a floor switch for a secret. The gray stone blocks set into the floor are solid — you can't walk through them, you have to walk around them. No two rooms are laid out the same — in every barn, Levels 1–9, each room has its own layout of stone blocks, crates and hay bales, so every room you step into looks and plays different from the last. At the end of each barn waits a big tough enemy — beat it and your hearts refill to 100% full right away, then grab the heart that appears and go on into the seed room and take that barn's barn piece — you step back outside at the end of every level with full hearts, Level 9 included. The screen blinks and you're back outside to search for the next barn. Want out early? Head back to the entry room — the room you came in — and walk out the 🚪 EXIT door in the south wall, right behind where you enter: it takes you straight back out onto the farm, any time, no questions asked.

🌑 Dark rooms: some barn rooms are pitch black — you can only see a little way around Corn Man, but the room holds things worth finding (like the key!). The Lantern 🔦 — 150 coin at the Country Store fixes that: press the orange LANTERN button (or L) and its fire lights the whole room for the rest of that barn visit. No lantern? You can still stumble through by memory… carefully!

🔒 Locks & keys — the whole idea, step by step: (1) Every barn hides one rusty key 🗝️ in a pitch-black dark room about a third of the way through the barn — walk over it to pick it up. (2) Keep following the path: a couple of rooms past the dark room is a padlocked door 🔒 (it says PADLOCKED — NEEDS A KEY right on it). (3) Just walk into that door while carrying the key — it clicks open and uses one key. That's all there is to it! Your key count rides at the top of the screen, and keys you don't spend carry over to every other barn. No key in your pocket? The dark room is always a couple of rooms back along the path from the padlocked door — head back and fetch it. The silver silo in the Level 7 yard is padlocked the same way — a tractor out in that yard carries its key.

🧩 The puzzle piece & the golden flash: beat the big enemy at the end of a barn, grab the heart, then follow the path on into the seed room — the barn's puzzle piece sits glowing on a golden pedestal at the top of the room, labelled ★ PUZZLE PIECE ★. Walk into it to take it: your Barn count ticks up right away (0/8 → 1/8), the screen flashes gold with sparkles for a second (that's the celebration, not a glitch!), your piece clicks into the barn puzzle — and Corn Man steps back out onto the farm, right by that barn's entrance, ready to hunt for the next one. Two seed rooms hide a second treasure beside the piece — the Silver Overalls in Level 3 and the Gold Overalls in Level 7: on those levels the barn does not close when you take the piece — it stays open until both treasures are collected, and only then does Corn Man step back out.

🧩 Collect all 8 barn pieces to complete the barn puzzle — that unseals The Great Barn on the north hill, where Super Corn Man is waiting! The moment the 8th piece lands, the screen flashes and a pop-up announces LEVEL 9 UNLOCKED! — press its DISMISS button to close it and keep exploring. Tap the 🧩 Barn chip up top at any time to pop up the Barn Puzzle: a conquered level shows the piece you collected, and a level you have not beaten yet shows its level number, marked MISSING.

💒 The wedding & World 2: beat Level 9 and Corn Man marries a beautiful woman in a white dress — they hold hands, kiss, and the screen flashes! Then a message sends you back to the Home Screen: your hero's information and tools are reset (fresh quest, empty pockets), and on Home you can now pick World 1 to replay or World 2. In World 2 all the levels are switched around on the farm — and the Super Hearts and hidden coins have moved too (the 🗺️ Farm Map shows World 2's layout) — and every level's end boss is 25% stronger. Beat World 2's Level 9 and the game is over: wedding, reset, and back Home, where you can pick World 1 or World 2 again.

🔁 Repeating a level: you can walk back into any barn you have already cleared. Beat its big end guy again and his heart still appears and still refills every heart — but the +1 max heart (super heart) is granted only the FIRST time you beat each level's boss. And in the seed room, anything you already collected — the puzzle piece, and the Silver Overalls or Gold Overalls — is simply not there any more. If everything that room held is already yours, you walk into the empty room and, after a couple of seconds, a small message in the room states Puzzle Piece Collected — press its DISMISS — GO TO GAME button and Corn Man steps back out onto the game screen by that level's barn. No piece is ever counted twice.

🗺️ Farm Map: tap the green 🗺️ MAP button up top (or press M) to see the whole farm laid out — all 128 fields in a 16 × 8 grid, like the original Zelda's overworld, and where every level's entrance is: L1–L8 plus the Great Barn. Your field is outlined in gold with a 📍. Tap any field on the map to see its name. The map only shows where to go — you still have to walk there and find the entrance yourself!

🧭 Level Map: the Level Map only appears when you ask for it — it never pops up on its own. While you are inside a barn, press the green 🧭 LEVEL MAP button up top, right beside the 🧩 Barn chip, and a small live copy of the map opens, filling in room by room as you walk — on a big screen it opens right beside the barn, and on a phone it opens right on top of the game screen. When you're done studying it, press its ✖ DISMISS button and it goes away — on a phone the game screen comes right back, just as it was. Its FULL MAP button opens the big version (the ☰ menu and N open that big one too, and its green button at the top closes it) — and here's the fun part: the rooms are laid out in the shape of that level's big end guy! Level 1's map is a giant chicken 🐔, Level 2's a snapping turtle 🐢, the tractor levels are tractors 🚜, and the Great Barn's map is Super Corn Man 🌽 himself. Every barn holds 15 to 25 rooms. Every room starts grayed out; the moment you step into a room, that room turns yellow on the map (just on the map — the room itself looks the same). A blinking red light 🔴 marks the room where the level's big end guy waits. Your rooms stay marked for that farmer, so you can check the map on your next visit and see where you've already been.

🏪 16 Country Stores: the farm is BIG now, so there are 16 Country Stores spread all through the grid — one on your home farm and 15 more out in the fields, each marked 🏪 on the Farm Map. Every store sells the same goods at the same prices; walk into any store building to shop.

👹 The end guys: L1 🐔 Giant Chicken (pecks at you and spits fireballs 🔥) · L2 🐢 Snapping Turtle (stretches its neck out to bite, and spits fireballs 🔥) · L3 🚜 Runaway Tractor (drives straight at you) · L4 👩‍🌾 Farmer Wife (swings a rolling pin) · L5 🦉 Giant Owl (flies at you) · L6 🕷️ Giant Spider (spits webs — only arrows can hurt it!) · L7 🚜 Super Tractor on treads (tries to run you over) · L8 👨‍🌾👨‍🌾 Two Farmers with pitchforks (only the corn thrower can hurt them!) · L9 🌽 Super Corn Man (only the corn thrower and gold arrows can hurt him!)

🧑‍🌾 Farmers: the Home screen always shows your 5 farmer slots — Farmer 1 through Farmer 5 — each labeled with the name in that slot. Tap a filled slot (or type its name) and press START GAME; an empty slot fills with the next new name you enter. Every farmer keeps their own items, coins, hearts and barn pieces — pick a farmer again and they start with the gear from their previous play. To free a slot, tap 🗑 DELETE on that farmer — the game asks "Are you sure?" first, and nothing is removed until you tap YES, DELETE. Switch farmers any time from the ☰ menu.

🚶 Move: ↑←↓→ or W A S D, or the touch pad.

⏸️ Pause: tap the orange ⏸ PAUSE button up top while playing (or the ☰ menu's Pause Game entry, or press P or Esc) and the whole game holds still — Corn Man, the critters and the music too. Tap ▶ RESUME (the same button, or the paused screen's RESUME GAME button) to pick up right where you left off.

⚔️ Swing corn sword: SPACE or J — or the red SWING button.

🌽 Throw a kernel: K or X — or the orange THROW button.

🪙 Drops: when you defeat an enemy, it leaves corn 🌽 or coins 🪙 behind on the field — walk over the drop to pick it up (tougher critters leave more, and the big end guys leave a coin pile and a corn pile). Sometimes an enemy drops a shiny gold coin ✨ worth 5 coins instead — it sparkles gold with a ×5 label, so grab it before it fades! Every once in a while a defeated enemy drops a glowing Power Heart 💖 — a big pink-and-gold heart with a POWER label — walk over it to heal 1 heart. Spend coins at a 🏪 Country Store — walk into any of the 16 store buildings spread across the farm (or use the ☰ menu): Hearts 10, Arrows 25, Bow 50, Overalls 100, Oil Can 100, Lantern 150, Gold Arrows 200.

🏹 Bow & arrows: you start with 25 arrows. Buy the Bow at the store, then shoot with F or the BOW button. Every arrow shot uses 1 arrow and costs 1 corn.

✨🏹 Gold arrows: a pack of 10 costs 200 coin at the store. Shoot one with G or the GOLD button (you still need the Bow). Gold arrows are the only arrows that can hurt Super Corn Man on Level 9 — stock up before you go in!

🔧 Wrenches: get the free Wooden Wrench (and the corn thrower) at the first shop visit. Throw it with T or the WREN button. With full hearts it flies across the whole screen; with hurt hearts it only flies a few feet. It stuns an enemy, then destroys it. At 5 hearts your wrench turns Silver (4× power); at 10 hearts it turns Golden (8× power). You gain +1 heart every time you beat a level!

🛢️ Oil Can: 100 coin at the store, 2 uses. Tap the 🛢️ chip up top (or press O) to fill your hearts to 100% full. It shows how many uses are left, and it's gone after 2 uses.

👕 Overalls from the store block some damage. Even better: Silver Overalls wait in the Level 3 seed room and Gold Overalls in the Level 7 seed room!

❤️ Watch your hearts. Defeated critters leave corn or coins behind, and sometimes a heart — walk over a drop to pick it up before it fades. Hearts refill when you step into a barn. If Corn Man falls out on the farm, TRY AGAIN replays the very field he fell on — he wakes up right there, hearts full — while BACK TO THE FARM takes him home to the home farm instead. Fall inside a barn and TRY AGAIN walks him back in that barn's front door.

🔥 Lantern fire: once you carry the Lantern, press the orange LANTERN button (or L) and fire shoots out the way Corn Man is facing. Fire lights dark rooms — and it can burn things, but not everything burns: only special hay bales and the little barns and sheds catch fire — they glow warm so you can spot them. Every other bale, bush and building just puts the flame out. What the burnable ones are hiding is in the Secrets below!

🤫 Secrets — water & the ladder: a wide moat of water rings The Great Barn — all the way around, with no gap and no opening in it, and no bridge. The only way over it is a small ladder 🪜 hidden under a hay bale somewhere out on the farm — burn the right bale with the lantern's fire and the ladder appears where the bale stood. Walk over it to pick it up, and Corn Man carries it from then on — for good. The ladder is never used up: it is not a one-time thing. Cross water once or a hundred times, fall and TRY AGAIN, even restart the whole quest — the ladder stays in his hand, saved with his hero. From then on, just touch any water and he climbs over it: water becomes walkable for him, anywhere — all the way around the moat, and across any other water you find on the farm. No ladder, no crossing — water blocks him cold!

💧 The Water of Life — the little healing ponds: two fields — 6 across, 1 down, the North Old Pasture, and 14 across, 3 down, the Northeast High Grass — each marked 💧 on the Farm Map, have a little pond in the bottom-left corner. Touch its water and Corn Man's energy comes back: his hearts refill half a heart at a time, one every half second, until they are completely full. These ponds are the one water he can wade into without the ladder. Step out of the water and the refilling stops where it is; step back in and it carries on.

🤫 Secrets — Super Hearts: 5 special hay bales are hidden out on the farm, glowing warm like everything the lantern can burn. Burn one and a Super Heart 💖 appears where it stood — walk over it and your max hearts go up by 1: 3 hearts become 4, up at the top left. Find and burn all 5! (With the extra heart from each beaten level too, Corn Man can reach 16 hearts in all by the end of the quest.)

🤫 Secrets — little barns & sheds: 16 fields around the farm have a little red barn or a wooden shed standing on them — they glow warm like the special bales, and the lantern's fire burns them down too. Underneath some of them — 9 of the 16 — a stash of 100 COINS 🪙 is hidden: burn the building, and a glittering coin pile appears where it stood — walk over it to pocket the 100 coins. The other 7 hide nothing at all. A burned barn or shed stays burned for that hero, and an unclaimed stash keeps waiting on the spot. The Farm Map 🗺️ marks the fields hiding the coins with a 🪙 — and the Super Heart fields with a 💖 and the ladder's field with a 🪜.

🌾 Hay bales & bushes: every field is scattered with hay bales and bushes to maneuver around — they're solid, so weave between them, duck behind them to dodge a charging critter, and use them to break up a chase. Just don't let them corner you!

🐔 Chickens wander, 🐷 pigs charge, 🐦 crows swoop, 🎃 scarecrows are tough, 🐐 goats zigzag, and mini 🚜 tractors rumble straight at you. Good luck, Corn Man!
